pr.body:
This continues the original manuscript Theorem 1.1 / Corollary 1.2 proof at manuscript ba6ec11d800eccc54406490631895e174de85766. It proves actual prime-box test-function limits, uniform Euler normalization, exact first-exit selection and tuple dictionaries, signed difference multiplicity, and the original small-core finite Fourier and smooth-frequency tail payments. All original selectors, complex coefficients, signed frequencies, outside moments, constants and quantifier order are retained.

The latest additions prove the smooth common-D frequency approximation with an arbitrarily strong logarithmic tail payment and exact stopped-frontier tuple/reciprocal-weight reindexing. Both pass strict compilation, original stock replay, and complete serialized/generated declaration, type, safety and transitive-axiom checks at the fixed toolchain and dependency pins. The archived checkpoint covers 163 modules and 3,799 declarations; its explicit source/archive/index/commit byte audit passed. Failed attempts remain archived.

This is a component checkpoint. The retained nonzero spectral estimate, original same-policy sharp upper bound K, complete selected Chen lower ledger C, and unconditional hLower/hUpper are still open. No aggregate root build, complete imported-closure replay, or unconditional 1+1.75 proof is claimed. CI and automation controls are unchanged.
pr.title: Prove original-core smooth Fourier tails and exact sieve inputs
